findings.title: The document does not declare its language
findings.summary: The root html element has no non-empty lang attribute, so assistive technology cannot reliably select pronunciation rules.
reproductionSteps: Open the page in a clean browser context.
Inspect the lang attribute on the root html element.

remediation.summary: Declare the page's primary BCP 47 language tag on the root html element.
technicalHints: Use a specific tag such as en, zh-CN, or ar and update it when the document language changes.

zh-CN.title: 文档没有声明语言
zh-CN.summary: 根 html 元素没有非空 lang 属性，辅助技术无法可靠选择发音规则。
reproductionSteps: 在干净的浏览器上下文中打开页面。
检查根 html 元素的 lang 属性。

remediation.summary: 在根 html 元素上声明页面主要语言的 BCP 47 标签。
technicalHints: 使用 en、zh-CN 或 ar 等明确标签，并在文档语言变化时同步更新。

findings.title: Document title does not meet the publishing policy
findings.summary: Found 1 title element(s) with a rendered length of 1; expected exactly one and 10–70 characters.
reproductionSteps: Open the page in a fresh context.
Inspect the document title length state without retaining title or description text.

remediation.summary: Provide one concise, page-specific title within the configured length range.

zh-CN.title: 文档标题不符合发布策略
zh-CN.summary: 发现 1 个 title 元素，渲染长度为 1；策略要求恰好一个且长度为 10–70 个字符。
reproductionSteps: 在新的浏览器上下文中打开页面。
检查文档的 title length 状态，但不保留标题或描述正文。

remediation.summary: 提供一个简洁且针对当前页面的标题，并满足配置的长度范围。

findings.title: Meta description does not meet the publishing policy
findings.summary: Found 0 description element(s) with a first length of 0; expected exactly one and 50–180 characters.
reproductionSteps: Open the page in a fresh context.
Inspect the document meta description length state without retaining title or description text.

remediation.summary: Add one accurate, page-specific meta description within the configured range; do not stuff keywords.

zh-CN.title: Meta description 不符合发布策略
zh-CN.summary: 发现 0 个 description 元素，第一个长度为 0；策略要求恰好一个且长度为 50–180 个字符。
reproductionSteps: 在新的浏览器上下文中打开页面。
检查文档的 meta description length 状态，但不保留标题或描述正文。

remediation.summary: 添加一个准确且针对当前页面的 meta description，并满足长度范围；不要堆砌关键词。

findings.title: Canonical link is missing, duplicated, or invalid
findings.summary: Found 0 canonical link(s); policy requires exactly one valid HTTP(S) destination.
reproductionSteps: Open the page in a fresh context.
Inspect the document canonical link state without retaining title or description text.

remediation.summary: Emit exactly one reviewed absolute canonical URL for this document.

zh-CN.title: Canonical 链接缺失、重复或无效
zh-CN.summary: 发现 0 个 canonical 链接；策略要求恰好一个有效的 HTTP(S) 目标。

remediation.summary: 为当前文档输出恰好一个经过审核的绝对 canonical URL。

remediation.summary: Provide one reviewed viewport declaration that includes width=device-width.

findings.title: Page is marked noindex against publishing policy
findings.summary: A robots directive contains noindex on a route configured for indexable publication.
reproductionSteps: Open the page in a fresh context.
Inspect the document robots indexing directive state without retaining title or description text.

remediation.summary: Remove noindex only after confirming this route is intended for public indexing and no equivalent header blocks it.

zh-CN.title: 页面的 noindex 标记违反发布策略
zh-CN.summary: 配置为可索引发布的路由包含 robots noindex 指令。
reproductionSteps: 在新的浏览器上下文中打开页面。
检查文档的 robots indexing directive 状态，但不保留标题或描述正文。

remediation.summary: 确认该路由确实用于公开索引且没有等效响应头阻止后，再移除 noindex。

findings.title: Page does not expose exactly one primary heading

reproductionSteps: Open the page in a fresh context.
Inspect the document primary heading count state without retaining title or description text.

remediation.summary: Keep one page-specific h1 and demote or consolidate competing top-level headings without hiding content.

zh-CN.title: 页面没有恰好一个主标题
zh-CN.summary: 发现 2 个 h1 元素；发布策略要求恰好一个。
reproductionSteps: 在新的浏览器上下文中打开页面。
检查文档的 primary heading count 状态，但不保留标题或描述正文。

remediation.summary: 保留一个针对当前页面的 h1，并在不隐藏内容的前提下降级或合并其他顶级标题。
